Fresh from the oven

A cabinet full of savoury pies, sweet doughnuts and warm cinnamon rolls — the Rotorua locals' morning stop.

Savoury pies

Smoked fish, seafood prawn mussel, creamy chicken, butter chicken, steak & oyster, lamb & cheese — and the pork belly pie Rotorua's pie hunters rate.

Filled doughnuts

Raspberry, custard, Ferrero, Kinder, banoffee, Dubai and caramel — generously filled, every single day.

A Rotorua favourite

Baked early, gone by lunch

Daily Dose starts early so Rotorua can start well — pies out of the oven, doughnuts filled, and cinnamon rolls still warm when the doors open.

With two locations — 80 White Street and 2/22 Kokako Street — there's always a Daily Dose near you, whether you're grabbing breakfast on the run or ordering catering for the whole crew.
